full_judgment: 12. Ordinarily this Court cannot adjudicate any factual aspect even in a case of reversal where there is no misreading or miss-appreciation of evidence by the lower Court, but in .the instant case the vital question of law has been reaised by the petitioner and as such I am of the view that this Court exercising the power under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure has got ample jurisdiction to see or examine the impugned order where there is an allegation of misreading of law.
